title: Test forms have bounded Euclidean coefficient norm
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every set U ⊆ ℝ^P and every test form ω ∈ TestFormOn U n, there is C ∈ ℝ with C > 0 and covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ C for every x ∈ ℝ^P. Here a test form is a ContDiff ℝ ∞ (smooth), compactly supported n-form x ↦ ω(x) ∈ Covector (Eucl P) n on ℝ^P with tsupport ω ⊆ U.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (ω : TestFormOn U n), ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x) ≤ C
